description: Converting the paddy purchased by the Paddy Marketing Board to rice and releasing them to the market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The paddy purchased by the Paddy Marketing Board during the last Yala season using funds of about Rs.6,000 million allocated in the 2025 budget, has already been stored in the warehouses belonging to the Paddy Marketing Board. In order to ensure a continuous supply of rice in the market, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation; and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to take necessary action to mill the said stock of paddy through the paddy mill owners registered with the Paddy Marketing Board for the year 2025 and release those to the market through the Lak Sathosa and the Cooperative network, was approved by the Cabinet.
